description: Recognizes running page furniture as ONE header_footer_page_number block: a running header/footer, a page number, or a repeated masthead line that is NOT document content.
applicability: The region is a running header or footer, a page number, or a repeated masthead / running title in the top or bottom margin.
It repeats across pages and is not part of the body content.
instructions: Emit running headers, footers, and page numbers as block_type header_footer_page_number, kept non-content and in reading order.
Do NOT merge a running header/footer into an adjacent heading or paragraph, and do NOT promote a page number to a heading or a body block.
Keep this furniture out of the body's parent-child structure (parent_block_id null).

provenance.reason: General-document adaptation (MPDocBench): page furniture (header/footer/page number) is non-content; generalized from the legal document_metadata skill.
